arStrings.szText: {if:SF_45}{c_important}Touch of Death's{/c} strike Heals you for {c_number}[{SF_4}*{SF_2}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * {SF_4}*{SF_2})]){/c}.{else}{c_important}Touch of Death's{/c} infection Heals you for {c_number}[{SF_4}*100|1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * {SF_4})]){/c} per second for a total of {c_number}[{SF_4}*{SF_2}*100|%|]{/c} Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * {SF_4}*{SF_2})]){/c}. You Heal any remaining when the swarm hatches.{/if}
If {c_important}Touch of Death's{/c} strike hits a {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} enemy, {c_important}Touch of Death{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_49*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.
{if:SF_23}{c_important}Touch of Death's{/c} Vigor cost is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_46}*100|%|]{/c}.{else}{c_important}Touch of Death{/c} gains an additional Charge.{/if}

{c_important}Touch of Death's{/c} swarm bursts every second, applying {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_A_POISON_DOT}{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}[{buffduration:UPGRADE_A_POISON_DOT}]{/c} seconds to surrounding enemies.

{c_important}Touch of Death{/c} is also a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill which costs {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} Vigor and has no Cooldown. 

When a swarm is replaced early, it bursts for {c_number}[{SF_27}*100|%|]{/c} of the damage it would have done.

{c_important}Touch of Death{/c} becomes an {c_important}Eagle{/c} Skill that deals Lightning damage. 

{c_important}Touch of Death{/c} strikes an enemy, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_C}{/c} damage and conjuring a {c_important}{u}Spirit Storm{/u}{/c} which Sparks enemies for {c_number}{dot:TOOLTIP_STORM_DOT}{/c} damage. If the enemy dies before the {c_important}{u}Spirit Storm{/u}{/c} dissipates, conjure a second moving {c_important}{u}Spirit Storm{/u}{/c}. 

When you conjure a {c_important}{u}Spirit Storm{/u}{/c}, reduce {c_important}Touch of Death's{/c} Cooldown by {c_number}[SF_44]{/c} second.
